title: best strategy for a beginner with a small budget
author: Sensitive_Bodyy
selftext: i only have $200 to start and most apps just confuse me. i really do not want to blow my cash on day one. someone told me to try trades on a demo account first, and puprime was just the first one with a demo i found. it feels simple enough so far, well at least when it is fake money. what strategy makes sense for a small account like this
